bullets.t: Built an unsupervised clustering pipeline (HDBSCAN) that groups post-manufacturing chip failures by underlying root cause with no labeled ground truth, validated iteratively with domain engineers.
Engineered statistical features and anomaly detection workflows to strengthen process monitoring and accelerate failure analysis.
Architected scalable Snowflake and GCP/Azure workflows processing large-scale failure analysis data to power production analytics apps.
Built a Claude-based internal AI skill on top of a widely used Micron library, extending existing engineering workflows with automated analysis.
Partnered with engineering, manufacturing, and data teams to translate complex domain problems into scalable enterprise applications.
Tutor undergraduate students in Calculus I and II, covering limits, derivatives, integration techniques, sequences, and series.
Support upper-division CS coursework in Data Structures & Algorithms, Operating Systems, and Principles of Programming Languages.
Explain algorithmic complexity, trees and graphs, process scheduling, concurrency, memory management, and language semantics.
Guide students through debugging and problem decomposition, adapting explanations to build independent problem-solving skills.
Conducted a comparative study of spatio-temporal neural approaches to traffic incident detection in Intelligent Transportation Systems, including IncidentNet and physics-informed methods.
Built a RAG prototype over a Neo4j credit-risk graph (customers, credit history, loan purpose) using embeddings, a FAISS vector store, and local LLMs orchestrated with LangGraph.
Iterated on prompts and embedding choices to improve retrieval relevance for credit-risk questions.
Benchmarked image-generation models on rendering accurate, legible text and fine-tuned an open diffusion model with LoRA to improve text quality for slide and chart visuals.
Analyzed millions of industrial IoT sensor readings from rotating equipment and bearing systems.
Engineered temporal, frequency-domain, and multivariate features to capture degradation trends and failure indicators.
Developed predictive machine learning models forecasting equipment failures days in advance to support predictive maintenance strategies.
Delivered interpretable model outputs and failure explanations enabling data-driven maintenance planning.
Designed and deployed multiple production-grade AI applications serving academic and industry stakeholders.
Built full-stack applications integrating frontend systems with AWS-hosted APIs, DynamoDB databases, and cloud services.
Developed scalable cloud infrastructure using EC2, Lambda, and serverless architectures supporting real-time inference workloads.
Standardized deployment workflows and reusable cloud templates to accelerate development cycles.
Improved industrial slab-sizing accuracy from 76% to 97% using computer vision and image-processing pipelines.
Corrected camera distortion and improved model robustness through geometric calibration and targeted augmentation techniques.
Used YOLO and FastSAM to detect and segment slab edges, and derived position-dependent pixel-to-real-world scaling so measurements held wherever the slab sat in frame.
Developed OCR for low-quality warehouse imagery and hand-marked slab identifiers using image deblurring and a fine-tuned OCR model, automating material identification and inventory workflows.
Built XGBoost models forecasting finished-goods production time for plate-mill orders, grouping orders by setup similarity to cut changeovers.
Improved production planning efficiency by approximately 80% through predictive analytics and process optimization.
Designed logistics optimization systems reducing unused rake capacity and lowering transportation costs by roughly 60%.
Built internal digital platforms integrated with SAP systems and deployed on enterprise infrastructure.

extra.t: Built a Streamlit forecasting app on MS SQL Server data (predict, batch predict, retrain).

Worked with engineers from Amazon and Google on software architecture, development workflows, and code reviews.

items.head: Vision-Language Models for Surgical Video Analysis (Capstone)
items.after: Arizona State University (Advisor: Dr. Yalin Wang)

bullets.t: Developing vision-language models for neurosurgery video analysis, targeting surgical workflow and instrument recognition.
Building end-to-end PyTorch and Hugging Face pipelines to benchmark baseline and fine-tuned VLMs on real surgical video data.
Prototyping surgical video captioning and visual question answering systems, with experimental performance analysis.
Prototyped a Dockerized zero-shot CLIP frame-labeling service (FastAPI inference + Streamlit UI).
Built a native macOS app that semantically searches notes, PDFs, and screenshots and answers questions with an on-device language model, linking every answer to its source files.
Designed a privacy-first architecture: local embedding, indexing in SQLite, and inference with no data leaving the device.

items.head: Pulse: Personal Health & Activity Analytics
items.after: Swift, SwiftUI, HealthKit, Core ML, SwiftData

bullets.t: Built an iOS app that reads HealthKit activity, sleep, and workout data to surface trends, detect anomalies, and generate evidence-based summaries that separate correlation from causation, all on-device.
Built a detection, tracking, and identification system for camera-trap footage that is robust to low light, occlusion, and motion blur, with uncertainty-aware predictions.
Built an AI research assistant that retrieves across scientific papers, figures, tables, and citations, with grounded responses and citation verification.
Built a local-LLM app that turns GitHub commit and README activity into LinkedIn posts, spotlighting featured projects.
Developed computer vision models (YOLO, Faster R-CNN, SAM/FastSAM) to detect and classify wildlife species from camera trap datasets.
Improved robustness to motion blur, occlusion, and low-light environmental conditions.
Modeled user-item interactions as graph structures and trained graph-based recommendation models.
Leveraged graph learning techniques to improve recommendation relevance compared to collaborative filtering baselines.
Evaluated recommendation performance using ranking and relevance metrics.

items.head: Medical Image Analysis for Early Brain Tumor Detection

bullets.t: Trained a ResNet classifier and a U-Net segmentation model on brain MRI scans with preprocessing and augmentation, evaluated with accuracy, F1, Dice, and IoU, and served through a Streamlit demo.
Built a Streamlit dashboard that pulls market data (yfinance), computes risk-return metrics (Sharpe, Sortino), and compares Random Forest and LSTM price forecasts.
Built a platform that evaluates speech recognition models across accents, noise, and speaking conditions on accuracy, latency, and subgroup performance, with statistical significance testing.

Built a two-service, Dockerized prototype: a FastAPI inference service that samples video frames with OpenCV and scores them with zero-shot CLIP, and a Streamlit UI showing labeled frames and label counts.
Wired the services with Docker Compose, a shared data volume, and a health check gating startup.
Built a full-stack app with a React frontend and Python backend that parses resume PDFs and uses LLM prompts to generate resume feedback and internship-prep guidance.
Built an iOS app that centralizes HealthKit metrics across iPhone and Apple Watch using MVVM and async data fetching, with Keychain and Secure Enclave for secure storage and XCTest coverage.
